summary: Guards hold only changes that cannot be undone, and the rest become warnings.

fixes.title: Guards hold only lasting changes
fixes.text: Guards hold for approval only changes that cannot heal, such as weakening policies, mass removals, or the last Global Administrator or SuperAdmin.

fixes.title: Other issues in one daily mail
fixes.text: Large policy alignments and open gaps are warnings in one daily Data quality alert mail.

fixes.title: Clearer setup advice
fixes.text: When a tenant-root permission is refused during setup, you see only the published script to fix it.
